title: Key Accounts Manager Poultry - Kolkata
description:
The Position
 


  


 As a Key Account Manager, you will play a critical role in driving business growth by building strong, sustainable partnerships with key customers across your assigned territory. You will work closely with leadership, customers, and cross\-functional teams to create mutual value, achieve commercial objectives, and deliver business results in line with company strategy.
 


  


 Duties \& Responsibilities
 


  

  
* Achieve sales and profitability targets across key accounts within both broiler and layer segments.
  
* Identify, pursue, and successfully close new business opportunities through the execution of BIAH’s Integrated KAM and Customer Business Planning (CBP) programs.
  
* Consistently seek opportunities to expand business with existing customers while winning new opportunities through strategic account management.
  
* Deliver short and mid\-term financial targets for your assigned customers and territory.
  
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, decision\-makers, and management teams within customer accounts.
  
* Understand customer needs, challenges, and business priorities, and develop solutions that create value for both the customer and BIAH.
  
* Position BIAH as a trusted partner by identifying opportunities for collaboration and mutual growth.
  
* Lead the development of comprehensive customer solutions by combining BIAH products and services into compelling value propositions.
  
* Develop customer\-specific growth strategies based on market analysis, competitive insights, and customer objectives.
  
* Create and execute Key Account Business Plans aligned with local avian business strategies and organizational goals.
  
* Optimize account penetration and maximize share of wallet through strategic planning and execution.
  
* Build and lead effective key account teams to support account growth and opportunity success.
  
* Ensure clear communication, alignment, and successful execution of agreed account strategies.
  
* Collaborate with CX teams, Business Unit Managers, Area Business Managers, Business Service Heads, and other stakeholders to deliver customer success.
  
* Align budgets, investments, and resources with account opportunities to maximize return on investment.
  
* Provide accurate sales forecasts and business updates to support effective planning and decision\-making.
  
* Manage commercial agreements, pricing discussions, and receivables with assigned accounts.
  
* Identify mutual growth opportunities and contribute to performance planning and development discussions for team members.
  
* Regularly assess account potential, sales performance, market share, and growth opportunities by product segment and species.
  
* Gather and analyze market trends, customer insights, and competitive intelligence to strengthen business strategies.
  
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date customer information and activity records within the CRM system.
  
* Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account plans to drive sustainable growth.
  
* Maintain effective customer engagement through planned account interactions and agreed contact frequency.
  
* Utilize data, customer insights, and digital tools to prioritize opportunities and maximize business impact.
  
* Ensure all administrative responsibilities, reporting requirements, and customer records are completed accurately and on time.
  

  


  


 About our Future Employee
 


  

  
* Education : Bachelors degree, Masters degree Veterinary \- Medicine / Economics/ Agriculture degree DVM / Animal Husbandry / Master of Science or Economics and/or Master of Business Administration is preferred.
  
* Customer focused
  
* Leadership competencies
  
* Performance and Return on Investment\-driven personality
  
* Knowledge of Animal Health Industry Economics
  
* Ability to work and thrive in matrix team environment
  
* Proven ability to work cross\-functional
  
* Interpersonal and communication skills
  
* Proven field experience of at least 8\-10 years
  
* History of successful performance.
  
* Good English in word and writing
  
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, Outlook and database applications.
  
* Ability to travel (may include overnight travel).
  
* Should reside in assigned geography or be willing to relocate.
  

  


  


 READY TO APPLY?
 


  


 Click the “Apply On Company website” button. Create an account or sign in and continue to register your profile, upload your resume, and apply in the company site.
 


  

**Our Company**
 Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long\-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer\-ingelheim.com.
   

  

**Why Boehringer Ingelheim?**

 With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths \- and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
 



 Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.
 



 Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after \- as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.
 







 Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer\-ingelheim.com

title: Restaurant Onboarding Manager
description:
Experience Required: 3–6 Years
 



 CTC: 3\-3\.5 LPA
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**About Gintaa** 




 At Gintaa, were redefining how Indians order food. With our focus on affordability, exclusive restaurant partnerships, and hyperlocal logistics, we aim to scale across India’s Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities. We’re backed by a mission\-driven team and expanding rapidly – now’s the time to join the core tech leadership and build something impactful from the ground up.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced and execution\-driven
 **Restaurant Onboarding Manager** 
 to lead Gintaa’s restaurant acquisition and onboarding operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for identifying and acquiring high\-potential restaurant partners, managing commercial discussions, ensuring documentation and onboarding completion, coordinating menu and catalogue setup, driving restaurant activation, and ensuring that newly onboarded restaurants become successfully operational on the Gintaa platform.
 



 The ideal candidate must have
 **5–7 years of hands\-on experience specifically in restaurant onboarding, restaurant acquisition, merchant acquisition, food\-tech partnerships, or restaurant account management within the online food delivery ecosystem.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Restaurant Acquisition \& Market Expansion
 


* Own restaurant acquisition and onboarding targets across assigned territories, zones, and markets.
* Identify high\-potential restaurants, QSRs, cloud kitchens, local food brands, restaurant chains, and strategic merchant partners.
* Develop market\-level acquisition strategies based on cuisine gaps, customer demand, locality coverage, pricing, and restaurant popularity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective restaurant partners.
* Conduct regular market mapping and identify restaurants currently missing from Gintaa's portfolio.
* Drive both field\-based and strategic restaurant acquisition initiatives.
* Support Gintaa's expansion into new locations by rapidly developing the restaurant supply base.



  





 2\. Restaurant Onboarding
 


* Manage the complete restaurant onboarding lifecycle from initial contact to successful activation.
* Coordinate collection and verification of required restaurant information and documentation.
* Ensure restaurant profiles, menus, pricing, operating hours, images, bank details, tax information, and other required information are accurately captured.
* Coordinate internally for account creation and platform configuration.
* Ensure onboarding activities are completed within defined turnaround times.
* Maintain high onboarding quality and minimize errors that could affect restaurant operations or customer experience.



  





 3\. Commercial Negotiation \& Partner Conversion
 


* Conduct commercial discussions with restaurant owners, decision\-makers, and management teams.
* Clearly communicate Gintaa's value proposition and partnership model.
* Negotiate commercials and partnership terms within approved company guidelines.
* Handle objections and competitive comparisons effectively.
* Drive conversion of qualified restaurant leads into active partners.
* Maintain transparency in all commercial commitments made to restaurant partners.



  





 4\. Restaurant Activation \& Go\-Live
 


* Own the journey from
 **Lead → Meeting → Agreement → Documentation → Menu Setup → Onboarding → Go\-Live → First Order** 
 .
* Ensure newly onboarded restaurants become operational within the defined activation timeline.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners to resolve issues delaying activation.
* Track restaurants that have completed onboarding but have not gone live or received orders.
* Drive activation and first\-order completion for newly onboarded partners.
* Ensure restaurant partners understand the operational workflow before going live.



  





 5\. Menu \& Catalogue Readiness
 


* Ensure restaurant menus are accurately represented on the Gintaa platform.
* Coordinate menu collection, item categorization, pricing, descriptions, images, availability, add\-ons, and customization requirements.
* Ensure restaurant information including address, operating hours, cuisines, and contact details is accurate.
* Work closely with catalogue/content teams to minimize menu\-related errors.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners for timely menu updates whenever required.



  





 6\. Partner Training \& Operational Readiness
 


* Educate newly onboarded restaurant partners on order acceptance and management processes.
* Explain platform workflows, restaurant responsibilities, delivery coordination, cancellations, customer issues, and escalation procedures.
* Ensure restaurant staff understand how to efficiently manage online orders.
* Provide initial operational support during the restaurant's launch phase.
* Reduce early\-stage operational issues through effective onboarding and training.



  





 7\. Restaurant Partner Relationship Management
 


* Build strong working relationships with restaurant owners and key decision\-makers.
* Act as an escalation point during the initial onboarding and activation period.
* Understand restaurant partner concerns and coordinate internally for resolution.
* Maintain high levels of partner satisfaction throughout the onboarding journey.
* Ensure smooth handover of successfully activated restaurants to the relevant account management or restaurant operations team.



  





 8\. Team Management \& Leadership
 


* Lead and mentor Restaurant Acquisition Managers, Onboarding Executives, Business Development Executives, and field teams.
* Allocate territories and acquisition targets based on market potential.
* Conduct daily and weekly pipeline reviews with the team.
* Track individual and team\-level performance against defined targets.
* Coach team members on pitching, negotiation, objection handling, and restaurant conversion.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on acquisition quality, speed, ownership, and execution.



  





 9\. Market Intelligence \& Competition Tracking
 


* Maintain strong awareness of the local restaurant and food delivery ecosystem.
* Track competitor restaurant partnerships, market penetration, restaurant offers, and acquisition activities.
* Gather structured feedback from restaurant partners regarding market trends and competitor propositions.
* Identify cuisine, pricing, locality, and restaurant\-selection gaps in Gintaa's marketplace.
* Share actionable market intelligence with business leadership.



  





 10\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Restaurant Operations
* Catalogue/Menu Management
* Sales \& Business Development
* Finance
* Legal/Compliance
* Customer Support
* Delivery Operations
* Product \& Technology
* Marketing



  





 Ensure smooth movement of restaurant partners across the entire acquisition, onboarding, activation, and operational handover journey.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 Performance for this role will primarily be measured through:
 


* Number of Restaurants Acquired
* Qualified Lead\-to\-Onboarding Conversion %
* Restaurants Onboarded per Month
* Restaurant Activation / Go\-Live Rate
* Average Onboarding TAT
* Documentation Completion Rate
* Menu/Listing Accuracy
* Agreement\-to\-Go\-Live TAT
* Onboarding\-to\-First\-Order Conversion
* Restaurant Partner Drop\-Off Rate
* Acquisition Cost per Restaurant
* Restaurant Coverage by Zone
* Target vs. Achievement
* Team Productivity
* Restaurant Partner Satisfaction



  





 Required Experience \& Qualifications
 


* **5–7 years of relevant professional experience.**
* **Prior experience in the same domain – restaurant acquisition, restaurant onboarding, food\-tech merchant acquisition, or restaurant partnerships – is MANDATORY.**
* **Candidates without relevant restaurant/food\-delivery onboarding or acquisition experience will not be considered for this position.**
* **Proven experience working directly with restaurant owners, restaurant chains, QSRs, cloud kitchens, or food\-service businesses.**
* **Strong experience in restaurant acquisition, onboarding, activation, and commercial negotiations.**
* **Experience managing field sales/acquisition teams and territory\-level targets.**
* **Strong understanding of online food delivery marketplace operations.**
* **Graduate degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Hospitality, or a related discipline.**
* **MBA/PGDM will be an advantage.**
* **Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, CRM systems, MIS reporting, and performance dashboards.**
* **Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.**
* **Willingness to travel extensively within assigned markets and interact directly with restaurant partners.**

title: Patient Journey Partner - Ophthalmology
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

****Patient Journey Partner\- Ophthalmology****
****Location: Kolkata****
****The Position****
 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
   

  

 We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co\-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
   

  

****Your Opportunity****
* You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators
* You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public \& private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations
* You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations
* You will be leading collaboration in field through co\-creation of solutions for key accounts


****Who you are****
* You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4\+ years in Ophthalmology preferred
* You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: New-ADN-Sr. Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\- Assurance – Senior Manager**
 As part of our EY\-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for individual who should have Assurance related experience in the Asset Management industry.
   

  

 In addition to supporting the management of service delivery for several key clients, the incumbent should have the potential to coach managers in the Asset Management segment, provide technical support, deliver industry training and assist in growing the Asset Management practice.
   

  

**Your key responsibilitie**
**Manage and develop people**
* Be an effective manager by empowering, monitoring, coaching and motivating the team members.
* Identify development opportunities and training needs for high performing managers.
* Identify technical and non–technical training needs with respect to client servicing, decision making, people issues, etc
* Conduct Assurance team’s performance reviews, serve as a positive leader and mentor, and play a significant role in the team’s performance


**Manage business and clients**
* Develop and maintain strong relationship network with key contacts in the Asset Management sector of engagement teams
* Actively support the Sector agenda both in terms of growth and quality initiatives (e.g. improvement of service delivery, standardization of projects, new solutions, etc.)
* Enhance connectivity between GDS team and engagement teams and leverage good connections to identify more opportunities for work
* Actively support the communication agenda for the Asset Management sector
* Support the Segment Leader in developing annual growth, resource and activity plans
* Monitor KPIs (growth, quality feedback, utilization, risk management compliance, attrition, etc.) for the teams under supervision and take appropriate action wherever required


**Manage quality of service delivery**
* Identify sector–specific training needs, review and update current curriculum
* Assist in organizing and providing technical training (both Sector and Assurance methodology)
* Assist in addressing service delivery quality issues if and when they occur
* Support exceptional service delivery action programs
* Establish a practice of ‘Best Practice’ sharing within the Asset Management Segment teams


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
* Asset Management, assurance experience with specific focus on Hedge Funds and Private Equity
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Strong project and people management skills with experience in serving global clients
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) / CPA/ACCA)
* Approximately over 10 years of Assurance relevant experience with well\-known CA firms.
* International experience of over 2 years will be an added advantage


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
